profile.role_note: The free main character, in Spectro form. They apply Spectro Frazzle.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The free main character, in Spectro form. Build them to apply Frazzle for Zani or Phoebe teams. Limited characters will replace them later.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Emerald of Genesis (or Blazing Brilliance) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Use a Crit 4-cost, Spectro DMG 3-costs, and ATK% 1-costs. Treat Energy Regen as a top priority. Their Liberation is the main source of Spectro Frazzle stacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: A standard-banner 5-star. Its extra Energy Regen improves Liberation uptime — and uptime is everything for applying Frazzle. It is not a signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: More premium, damage-oriented option for certain teams.

ranked_weapons.name: Overture
ranked_weapons.note: Ideal 4-star for its Energy Regen plus Concerto Energy on skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Endless Collapse
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Energy and ATK on Resonance Skill; usable 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Fables of Wisdom
ranked_weapons.note: ATK buff on hitting enemies with Negative Statuses; another usable 4-star.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen for Liberation uptime. Her Outro gives the next DPS an ATK buff. The Heron adds Resonance Energy and more DMG for the next character.

echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: A damage-focused second option. It works with the Spectro Frazzle mechanic, but it buffs the DPS less.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: A niche third option, once S4 unlocks healing on their Liberation. It pushes them into an even more supportive role.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for their sub-DPS damage.
Spectro DMG on both. Swap one to Energy Regen if the Liberation is not cycling.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; ER is a top priority (less so after S3)

teams.name: Premium: Zani + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper

members.name: Zani
members.note: Spectro Frazzle payoff DPS; her damage scales off Frazzle stacks.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Dedicated Spectro Frazzle applicator; one of only three characters who can apply it.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and extra healing for sustainability; Mornye, Verina, and Buling are documented replacements.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm. Rover builds Forte to at least half. They cast their enhanced Resonance Skill for Frazzle and the Shimmer debuff. Then they cast Liberation and Outro into Zani's full combo. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm at the end.

teams.name: Alternative: Phoebe + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Documented main DPS replacement for Zani through her Absolution state.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Same Frazzle application role; Moonlit Clouds buffs the incoming DPS.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing and Crit buffs; Verina is the documented replacement.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with Stellarealm. Phoebe enters Confession mode and stacks Spectro Frazzle with Heavy Attacks and her Liberation. Rover tops up the Frazzle stacks and adds Outro buffs. Then the DPS closes the rotation.

sequences.verdict: All six unlock free, through the story and exploration. S0 is a complete Frazzle sub-DPS. S6 adds Spectro RES shred for the team.

pull_path.why: Full Frazzle application and Liberation rotation at S0.
+40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus — the biggest free damage node.
Resonating Slashes and Spin shred 10% Spectro RES for the team — the standout, still free.

nodes.name: Odyssey of Beginnings
nodes.effect: +15% Crit Rate for 7s after casting Resonating Slashes or Resonating Spin.

nodes.name: Resonating Lamella
nodes.effect: Echoing Resonance heals the team for 20% of ATK per second for 5s.

nodes.name: Echoes of Wanderlust
nodes.effect: Resonating Slashes and Resonating Spin reduce the target's Spectro RES by 10% for 20s.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: No signature exists. Emerald of Genesis (standard) covers them. Never pull on a weapon banner for Rover dupes.
